actions.name: Exploit CVE-2019-18935 in Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX on IIS server
actions.description: Threat actors exploited a .NET deserialization vulnerability (CVE-2019-18935) in Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX running on a Microsoft IIS server to achieve remote code execution.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Upload malicious DLL files to C:\Windows\Temp\ directory
actions.description: Threat actors uploaded malicious dynamic-link library (DLL) files, some masqueraded as PNG files, to the C:\Windows\Temp\ directory on the IIS server.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Execute malicious DLL files via w3wp.exe process
actions.description: Threat actors executed the uploaded malicious DLL files from the C:\Windows\Temp\ directory via the legitimate w3wp.exe process on the IIS server.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Delete DLL files with .dll extension from C:\Windows\Temp\ directory
actions.description: TA1's malware deleted files with the .dll extension from the C:\Windows\Temp\ directory to hide malicious activity.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Use timestomping to modify file creation dates
actions.description: Threat actors used timestomping to modify file time attributes to insert misleading creation dates on malicious files.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Conduct reconnaissance and scanning activities
actions.description: Multiple cyber threat actors, including TA1 and TA2, conducted reconnaissance and scanning activities correlating to exploitation of CVE-2019-18935.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: TA1 gather system and network information and communicate to C2 server
actions.description: TA1's malware collected system and network parameters and communicated this data to C2 servers at IP addresses 137.184.130[.]162 or 45.77.212[.]12 using unencrypted TCP over port 443.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: TA2 upload and execute masqueraded DLL files as PNG files
actions.description: TA2 uploaded malicious DLL files masqueraded as PNG files to the C:\Windows\Temp\ directory and executed them via the w3wp.exe process, which dropped and executed reverse shell utilities.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: TA2 malware attempts to connect to C2 domains and establish reverse shell
actions.description: TA2 malware attempts to connect to C2 domains xework[.]com or xegroups[.]com to obtain IP address and port for unencrypted communication, establish a listener, identify OS, create appropriate shell, and execute commands including dropping a base64-encoded ASPX webshell.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: TA2 malware drops and decodes base64 encoded ASPX webshell
actions.description: TA2 malware drops a base64 encoded text file small.txt which decodes to an ASPX webshell small.aspx that allows enumeration of drives, file operations, and command execution.
actions.epistemic_reason: 原文描述的是工具／惡意程式具備的能力，沒有說這個動作在本事件中實際發生。
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: TA1 and TA2 use non-application layer protocol (TCP) for C2 communication
actions.description: Threat actors used a non-application layer protocol (TCP) for w3wp.exe process exploitation, command and control, and enumeration on the IIS server.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Create malicious DLL file by w3wp.exe process
actions.description: Threat actors created malicious DLL files in the C:\Windows\Temp\ directory by the w3wp.exe process.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Load newly created DLL into running w3wp.exe process
actions.description: Threat actors loaded the newly created malicious DLL into a currently running IIS process w3wp.exe.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Make TCP connection using w3wp.exe process to C2 IP over port 443
actions.description: Threat actors made a TCP connection using w3wp.exe process to IP 45.77.212[.]12 over port 443.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Invoke Windows C runtime library to execute payload
actions.description: Threat actors invoked C:\Windows\System32\vcruntime140.dll (Windows C runtime library) to execute payload.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.
